title: 排序与截取
subtitle: 让结果按需要排列
lesson: ORDER BY ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序，默认是升序。多个排序字段按先后逐层比较。LIMIT 限制返回行数。取前 N 条时要先排序，并使用唯一编号作为并列时的第二排序字段，确保结果稳定。
example_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;

problems.title: 按注册时间排队
problems.prompt: 输出 customer_id、registered_at，按注册日期升序，日期相同再按客户编号升序。
problems.lesson: ORDER BY ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序，默认是升序。多个排序字段按先后逐层比较。LIMIT 限制返回行数。取前 N 条时要先排序，并使用唯一编号作为并列时的第二排序字段，确保结果稳定。
problems.example_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;
hints: 先写日期排序，再写唯一编号。
ORDER BY registered_at ASC, customer_id ASC
problems.answer_sql: SELECT customer_id,registered_at FROM customers ORDER BY registered_at,customer_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT customer_id,registered_at FROM customers ORDER BY registered_at DESC,customer_id

problems.title: 最贵的商品在前
problems.prompt: 输出 product_id、price，按价格降序，同价按商品编号升序。
problems.lesson: ORDER BY ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序，默认是升序。多个排序字段按先后逐层比较。LIMIT 限制返回行数。取前 N 条时要先排序，并使用唯一编号作为并列时的第二排序字段，确保结果稳定。
problems.example_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;
hints: ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC
problems.answer_sql: SELECT product_id,price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC,product_id
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT product_id,price FROM products ORDER BY price,product_id
equivalent_sql: SELECT product_id,price FROM training.products ORDER BY price DESC,product_id

problems.title: 订单按状态和时间排列
problems.prompt: 输出 order_id、status、order_date，先按 status 升序，再按日期降序，最后订单编号升序。
problems.lesson: ORDER BY ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序，默认是升序。多个排序字段按先后逐层比较。LIMIT 限制返回行数。取前 N 条时要先排序，并使用唯一编号作为并列时的第二排序字段，确保结果稳定。
problems.example_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;
hints: 同一状态内按较新的日期在前。
ORDER BY status ASC, order_date DESC, order_id ASC
problems.answer_sql: SELECT order_id,status,order_date FROM orders ORDER BY status ASC,order_date DESC,order_id ASC
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT order_id,status,order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_id

problems.title: 找到前十件高价商品
problems.prompt: 输出 product_id、product_name、price，价格降序，同价商品编号升序，仅取前 10 件。
problems.lesson: ORDER BY ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序，默认是升序。多个排序字段按先后逐层比较。LIMIT 限制返回行数。取前 N 条时要先排序，并使用唯一编号作为并列时的第二排序字段，确保结果稳定。
problems.example_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 3;
hints: ORDER BY price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 10
problems.answer_sql: SELECT product_id,product_name,price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC,product_id LIMIT 10
problems.wrong_sql: SELECT product_id,product_name,price FROM products ORDER BY price,product_id LIMIT 10
equivalent_sql: SELECT product_id,product_name,price FROM training.products ORDER BY price DESC,product_id LIMIT 10
